title: WOMD-Reasoning: A Large-Scale Dataset for Interaction Reasoning in Driving
authors_zh: Yiheng Li, Cunxin Fan, Chongjian Ge, Seth Z. Zhao, Chenran Li, Chenfeng Xu, Huaxiu Yao, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Bolei Zhou, Chen Tang, Mingyu Ding, Wei Zhan
paper_type_zh: 驾驶交互推理数据集与构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究驾驶语言监督、交互推理和 hindsight 泄漏的读者
one_line: WOMD-Reasoning converts 63,000 WOMD scenes into 2.94 million GPT-4 Turbo Q&As, including 409,000 interaction and intention records that may depend on future trajectories.
WOMD-Reasoning 将 6.3 万个 Waymo 运动场景转成 294 万条规则支撑与 LLM 撰写的问答，但生成式交互叙述和未来感知标签必须分别进行因果与质量审计。
why: It is a large driving-language supervision object with explicit scene lineage and released construction prompts, but reuse requires separating factual from generated reasoning, marking future-conditioned targets, and auditing the unverified majority of records.
inclusion_reason: WOMD-Reasoning exposes a scene-to-language construction pipeline in which structured trajectories and traffic rules become factual and reasoning Q&As, making the distinction between rule-derived context, LLM-authored supervision, and hindsight-conditioned labels directly relevant to reasoning-data audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official PMLR record, ICML 2025 paper, arXiv v3, author repository, and gated Waymo release are the primary sources for this Card. PMLR records the paper in Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, volume 267, pages 34288–34311.

WOMD provides trajectories, HD maps, and traffic-control state, but these structured fields do not directly supply natural-language supervision for reasoning about non-proximate interactions caused by right-of-way rules or driver intentions. WOMD-Reasoning addresses this gap by translating selected scenes into text and using Microsoft Azure GPT-4 Turbo to generate factual and reasoning Q&As.

The data object comprises 63,000 WOMD scenes and 2.94 million Q&As: 229,000 map, 326,000 ego-agent, 1.976 million surrounding-agent, 346,000 interaction, and 63,000 intention Q&As. It is relevant to instruction_demonstration_rationale_data as question–answer supervision and to environment_agent_trajectory_data because every record is grounded in a multi-agent motion scene. Collection value depends on retaining scene lineage and distinguishing present-state facts from future-conditioned interaction labels.

本卡以PMLR官方条目、ICML 2025论文、arXiv v3、作者代码仓库和受访问控制的Waymo发布页为主要来源。PMLR将论文收录于Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning第267卷,页码34288–34311。

WOMD提供轨迹、HD map和交通控制状态,但这些结构化字段不会直接形成关于路权规则或驾驶意图所引发远距离交互的自然语言监督。WOMD-Reasoning先把选中场景翻译为文本,再使用Microsoft Azure GPT-4 Turbo生成事实型与推理型问答。

数据对象包含63,000个WOMD场景和294万条问答:22.9万条地图、32.6万条自车、197.6万条周边agent、34.6万条交互及6.3万条意图问答。它作为问答监督对应instruction_demonstration_rationale_data,又因每条记录来自多agent运动场景而对应environment_agent_trajectory_data。其收录价值依赖场景lineage的保留,以及对当前事实与未来条件交互标签的明确区分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The pipeline separates an upstream structured substrate from an LLM-authored supervision object. A rule-based translator narrates intersections, lanes, signs, signals, ego and surrounding-agent state, relative positions, and future trajectories. GPT-4 Turbo receives that text and generates five ordered categories: map environment, ego motion, surrounding-agent motion, pairwise interaction, and ego intention.

The first three categories are called factual content and are intended to describe the current scene. Interaction and intention are the reasoning content. The released prompt explicitly tells the model to use both current and future descriptions for interaction answers and to summarize future-period interactions when inferring ego intention. Thus rule-derived input, generated factual Q&A, and generated future-conditioned reasoning are distinct evidence classes even though they appear in one scene record.

There is no programmatic correctness contract for a row. Human evaluation asks whether the correct answer is included, while model evaluation uses reference-overlap metrics, GPT Score, and limited numerical metrics. These are aggregate evaluation surfaces, not per-record verifiers or rewards.

该管线把上游结构化环境与LLM撰写的监督对象分开。规则translator叙述路口、车道、标志、信号、自车与周边agent状态、相对位置和未来轨迹;GPT-4 Turbo读取这些文本,按顺序生成地图环境、自车运动、周边agent运动、成对交互和自车意图五类问答。

前三类被论文称为事实内容,目标是描述当前场景;交互和意图属于推理内容。公开prompt明确要求交互回答同时使用当前与未来描述,并在推断自车意图时总结未来时段内的交互。因此,规则生成输入、生成式事实问答和未来条件推理是三类不同证据,即使它们存放在同一场景记录中。

数据没有逐记录程序化正确性契约。人工评估判断答案是否包含正确内容,模型评估则使用参考文本重叠指标、GPT Score和有限的数值指标;这些都是聚合评估面,不是逐条verifier或reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction starts from WOMD training and interactive-validation scenes carrying the objects_of_interest label. A rule program produces an ego-centric textual description of the HD map, traffic controls, present motion and position of the ego and surrounding vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians, their relative positions, and future states. The paper reports 52,000 training scenes and 11,000 validation scenes.

Microsoft Azure GPT-4 Turbo receives a prompt with four components: system role, five ordered responsibilities, global rules, and human-written in-context examples. It generates current-only environment, ego, and surrounding-agent Q&As, then uses current and future descriptions to generate one interaction Q&A per surrounding agent and an aggregate ego-intention Q&A. Generation reportedly cost about USD 12,750. Exact endpoint snapshot, temperature, sampling parameters, seeds, retry policy, parsing failures, rejection policy, and corrected-row ledger are unknown.

The repository describes per-scene JSON fields sid, ego, cur_time, future_time, rel_id, rel_qa_id, and paired env, ego, sur, and int question/answer arrays. Original agent IDs and substituted Q&A IDs coexist; the latter encode vehicles in [0,100), bicycles in [100,200), and pedestrians in [200,300). The release is split into training.tar.gz and validation_interactive.tar.gz, but the current Waymo archive requires sign-in and no immutable Card-level manifest is available.

For the visual extension, ScenarioNet and MetaDrive replay scenes as BEV and ego-view video; the paper specifies 90 frames at 10 Hz, with 10 historical and 80 future frames. Motion-LLaVA uses LLaVA-v1.5-7B with a MultiPath++ motion encoder and trains all components for one epoch. Human evaluation covers 1,610 Q&As judged by four people, but there is no automatic row-level acceptance predicate and further human cleaning was ongoing.

构造从WOMD训练集和interactive-validation中带objects_of_interest标签的场景开始。规则程序生成ego-centric文本,覆盖HD map、交通控制、自车与周边车辆/骑行者/行人的当前运动和位置、相对位置及未来状态。论文报告训练场景52,000个、验证场景11,000个。

Microsoft Azure GPT-4 Turbo接收由system角色、五项顺序责任、global rules和人工编写in-context示例组成的四段prompt。它先生成只使用当前信息的环境、自车和周边agent问答,再使用当前与未来描述,为每个周边agent生成一条交互问答,并生成汇总后的自车意图问答。论文报告API成本约12,750美元;精确endpoint版本、temperature、采样参数、seed、重试策略、解析失败、拒绝规则和修订ledger均为unknown。

仓库说明每个场景JSON包含sid、ego、cur_time、future_time、rel_id、rel_qa_id以及成对的env、ego、sur、int问答数组。原始agent ID与替换后的Q&A ID同时保留;后者用[0,100)表示车辆、[100,200)表示自行车、[200,300)表示行人。发布分为training.tar.gz与validation_interactive.tar.gz,但当前Waymo归档需要登录,Card中也没有不可变manifest。

视觉扩展使用ScenarioNet和MetaDrive重放BEV与ego-view视频;论文指定视频为10 Hz、90帧,其中10帧历史、80帧未来。Motion-LLaVA以LLaVA-v1.5-7B和MultiPath++运动encoder为基础,全部组件训练1个epoch。人工评估由4人判断1,610条问答,但不存在自动逐条接受谓词,后续人工清洗在论文发布时仍在进行。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 2 fixes the scale and composition: 2.43 million Q&As over 52,000 training scenes and 0.51 million over 11,000 validation scenes, totaling 2.94 million Q&As over 63,000 scenes. Of these, 346,000 are interaction Q&As and 63,000 are ego-intention Q&As. The repository independently confirms the two archive names and the JSON field layout.

Four people evaluated 1,610 Q&As by judging whether an answer included the correct answer. The paper reports 91.99% aggregate accuracy, 91.03% for interaction, and 87.50% for intention. It does not disclose a representative sampling design, inter-rater agreement, per-item labels, the size of the corrected subset, or whether evaluated rows are distributed with the release; these aggregate figures therefore cannot certify the other records.

Motion-LLaVA is evaluated on 1,000 randomly selected validation Q&As using ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr, SPICE, GPT Score, and factual numerical metrics. It reports 56.2% accuracy within a 1.0-meter tolerance and median error 1.0 for factual answers. A downstream MultiPath++ experiment reports improvements when Motion-LLaVA interaction outputs are added. These results demonstrate studied uses and model behavior; they are not proof that each generated Q&A is correct, causally usable, uncontaminated, or safely licensed.

表2给出了规模与组成:52,000个训练场景对应243万条问答,11,000个验证场景对应51万条问答,合计63,000个场景、294万条问答。其中34.6万条为交互问答,6.3万条为自车意图问答。作者仓库还独立确认了两个归档名称和JSON字段布局。

4名评估者判断1,610条问答中是否包含正确答案。论文报告整体准确率91.99%、交互问答91.03%、意图问答87.50%。但代表性采样设计、评估者一致性、逐条标签、修订子集规模,以及评估记录是否随发布提供均未披露,因此这些聚合数字不能认证其余记录。

Motion-LLaVA在随机选取的1,000条验证问答上使用ROUGE、BLEU、METEOR、CIDEr、SPICE、GPT Score及事实数值指标评估;事实回答在1.0米容差内的准确率报告为56.2%,median error为1.0。下游MultiPath++实验还报告加入Motion-LLaVA交互输出后的改进。这些结果说明论文研究过的用途与模型行为,但不能证明每条生成问答都正确、具备因果可用性、无污染或许可证安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier driving-language datasets commonly emphasize captions, proximity-based interactions, perception questions, or much smaller collections. WOMD-Reasoning changes the construction target toward traffic-rule-induced and intention-induced interactions that can exist even when agents are initially far apart, and scales this target across 63,000 real-world WOMD scenes.

The specific contribution is the combination of a rule-based motion-to-text translator, a structured five-part Q&A chain, future-aware interaction and intention generation, and optional simulated vision aligned to the same motion scene. The split between factual questions and interaction reasoning also supplies a concrete scaffold for Motion-LLaVA training and inference.

What is not new should remain explicit: WOMD-Reasoning does not introduce WOMD, general-purpose chat-model prompting, rule-based scene translation, LLaVA, MultiPath++, ScenarioNet, MetaDrive, SFT, or reference-based language evaluation. Its reported scale and benchmark results do not themselves establish record-level correctness. Reuse should be evaluated by lineage completeness, causal input availability, verifier coverage, and release reproducibility rather than by dataset size alone.

既有驾驶语言数据通常侧重caption、近距离交互、感知问答或更小规模的数据。WOMD-Reasoning把构造目标转向交通规则与驾驶意图引发的交互,这类交互即使在agent初始距离较远时也可能存在,并把该目标扩展到63,000个真实WOMD场景。

其具体贡献是组合规则式motion-to-text translator、结构化五类问答链、使用未来信息的交互/意图生成,以及与同一运动场景对齐的可选模拟视觉数据。事实问题与交互推理的划分还为Motion-LLaVA训练和推理提供了明确scaffold。

必须明确哪些并非新贡献:WOMD-Reasoning没有提出WOMD、通用对话模型prompting、规则式场景翻译、LLaVA、MultiPath++、ScenarioNet、MetaDrive、SFT或参考文本语言评估。规模和benchmark结果本身不能建立逐记录正确性。复用判断应基于lineage完整性、因果输入可获得性、verifier覆盖与发布可复现性,而不是只看数据规模。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Only 1,610 Q&As receive the reported aggregate human evaluation, versus 2.94 million released Q&As. Sampling, per-item labels, evaluator agreement, corrected rows, and rejected-generation logs are not disclosed.
  • Interaction and intention prompts explicitly use future scene descriptions. These labels contain privileged hindsight and cannot be treated as online prediction targets unless future-dependent fields are marked or removed.
  • The rule-based translation is the only scene representation observed by GPT-4 Turbo. Translation errors, omitted actors, map errors, and heuristic relation errors can therefore propagate into every generated category.
  • Selection through WOMD objects_of_interest favors already identified interactive scenes. Coverage and error rates may not transfer to ordinary, weak-interaction, rare, or out-of-distribution driving scenes.
  • Exact Azure model snapshot, decoding settings, seeds, retries, parser, rejection policy, prompt revision, Waymo archive revision, and dataset file hashes are unknown. The repository has no tagged release, and Waymo access is gated.
  • The repository license and Waymo terms both apply. Agent-ID substitution is described as preventing overfitting, not as anonymization or complete provenance; commercial and derivative reuse needs a separate rights review.

• 报告的聚合人工评估只覆盖1,610条问答,而发布总量为294万条;采样方式、逐条标签、评估者一致性、修订记录和拒绝生成日志均未披露。
  • 交互与意图prompt明确使用未来场景描述。这些标签包含特权hindsight;若不标记或移除未来依赖字段,就不能把它们视为在线预测目标。
  • 规则翻译文本是GPT-4 Turbo观察场景的唯一表示。翻译错误、遗漏agent、地图错误和启发式关系错误都可能传播到所有生成类别。
  • 通过WOMD objects_of_interest选择场景,会偏向已识别的显著交互案例;覆盖率与错误率未必能迁移到普通、弱交互、罕见或分布外驾驶场景。
  • 精确Azure模型版本、解码设置、seed、重试、parser、拒绝策略、prompt版本、Waymo archive版本和数据文件哈希均为unknown。仓库没有tagged release,Waymo访问也受限。
  • 仓库许可证与Waymo条款同时适用。agent ID替换被描述为防止过拟合,而不是匿名化或完整来源证明;商业及衍生复用需要单独进行权利审查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For instruction_demonstration_rationale_data, the release supplies paired driving questions and answers across factual description, pairwise interaction reasoning, and aggregate intention. It can support SFT or evaluation of motion-language models, provided builders preserve category labels and do not conflate generated answers with deterministically verified facts.

For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the useful unit is the scene-linked record: WOMD scene ID, original and substituted agent IDs, current and future timestamps, map and signal context, questions, answers, and optional rendered frames. Causal prediction studies should expose only current and historical observations while separately marking answers that were constructed from future trajectories.

An auditable reuse package should pin the WOMD archive and split manifest, repository commit, translator and prompt hashes, Azure model snapshot and decoding settings, raw response, parser result, retry/rejection history, human-review labels, correction history, and license lineage. Visual reuse should additionally pin ScenarioNet, MetaDrive, camera configuration, frame range, and whether future frames are included.

The dataset can be used to study traffic-rule reasoning, interaction explanation, motion-language SFT, scene-grounding errors, hindsight leakage, and the gap between offline annotation and online deployment. Reported model and trajectory-prediction improvements motivate these uses but do not certify the transformed dataset.

对instruction_demonstration_rationale_data而言,该发布提供覆盖事实描述、成对交互推理和汇总意图的驾驶问答,可用于motion-language模型的SFT或评测;前提是保留类别标签,并且不把生成回答与确定性验证事实混为一谈。

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言,可复用单元是场景关联记录:WOMD scene ID、原始与替换后的agent ID、当前/未来时间、地图与信号上下文、问题、答案及可选渲染帧。因果预测研究只能暴露当前和历史观测,并应单独标记由未来轨迹构造的答案。

可审计复用包应固定WOMD archive与split manifest、仓库commit、translator与prompt哈希、Azure模型版本和解码设置、原始响应、parser结果、重试/拒绝历史、人工审核标签、修订历史与许可证lineage。视觉复用还应固定ScenarioNet、MetaDrive、相机配置、帧范围及是否包含未来帧。

该数据可用于研究交通规则推理、交互解释、motion-language SFT、场景grounding错误、hindsight泄漏,以及离线标注与在线部署之间的差距。论文报告的模型与轨迹预测改进可以说明这些用途值得研究,但不能认证转换后数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The released object is 63,000 scene-linked records containing 2.94 million Q&As, not 2.94 million independently sourced scenes.
  • All Q&A categories are generated by GPT-4 Turbo from rule-produced text; the translator is grounding input, not a per-answer verifier.
  • Interaction and intention answers explicitly use future descriptions and must be labeled as hindsight-conditioned supervision.
  • Human evaluation covers 1,610 Q&As and reports 91.99% overall accuracy; it is not a certificate for every row.
  • Preserve sid, original agent IDs, substituted Q&A IDs, current/future time, category, prompt revision, and correction provenance; Waymo access, layered licensing, missing generation settings, and unpinned release revisions remain material reuse blockers.

• 发布对象是63,000个场景关联记录、合计294万条问答,而不是294万个独立来源场景。
  • 所有问答类别都由GPT-4 Turbo根据规则文本生成;translator只是grounding输入,不是逐回答verifier。
  • 交互和意图回答明确使用未来描述,必须标记为hindsight-conditioned监督。
  • 人工评估覆盖1,610条问答并报告整体91.99%准确率,不是每条记录的证书。
  • 应保留sid、原始agent ID、替换Q&A ID、当前/未来时间、类别、prompt版本和修订provenance;Waymo访问、分层许可证、缺失生成设置和未固定发布版本仍是重要复用阻碍。

value.html: LLaVA-v1.5-7B is the language-model base for Motion-LLaVA; a MultiPath++ implementation supplies the motion-vector encoder.

value.html: Microsoft Azure GPT-4 Turbo.
Rule-based WOMD-to-text translation followed by a four-part prompt consisting of system, responsibility, global-rule, and in-context components. GPT-4 Turbo produces factual and reasoning Q&As.

value.html: 52,000 WOMD training scenes produce about 2.43 million Q&As and 11,000 interactive-validation scenes produce about 0.51 million Q&As, for 63,000 scenes and 2.94 million Q&As total. The reasoning portion contains 346,000 interaction Q&As and 63,000 intention Q&As.

items: Rule-translator errors propagate because its text is the only scene representation observed by GPT-4 Turbo.
Interaction and intention targets use future trajectories, creating hindsight-conditioned supervision that is not causally available in online deployment.
The objects_of_interest selection concentrates the release on scenes already marked as significantly interactive and may not represent ordinary driving scenes.
Only 1,610 of 2.94 million Q&As receive the reported aggregate human evaluation; the sampling method, corrected subset size, and record-level judgments are not released.
LLM-generated answers have no per-record formal verifier, confidence, rejection reason, or correction provenance.
The Waymo download is access-gated, and the repository has no tagged release; exact archive, prompt, translator, and API revisions are not pinned together.
Agent-ID substitution is described as an anti-overfitting measure, but it does not by itself provide a complete transformation or rights ledger.
规则转换器错误会传播，因为其文本是 GPT-4 Turbo 观察到的唯一场景表示。
交互与意图目标使用未来轨迹，造成在线部署中因果上不可用的后见条件化监督。
objects_of_interest 选择使发布集中于已被标为显著交互的场景，可能无法代表普通驾驶场景。
2.94 million Q&As 中仅 1,610 条接受所报告的汇总人工评测；抽样方法、已更正子集规模与记录级判定未发布。
LLM 生成答案没有逐记录形式验证器、置信度、拒绝原因或更正出处。
Waymo 下载为访问门控，且仓库无带标签发布；精确归档、提示、转换器与 API 修订未被一起钉扎。
Agent-ID 替换被描述为抗过拟合措施，但本身并不提供完整的转换或权利台账。

value.html: The repository license permits educational, research, and not-for-profit use and grants specified commercial rights to BDD and BAIR Commons members and affiliates; other commercial licensing requires separate contact. The annotations are also subject to Waymo terms. A record-level license and provenance ledger is not published.

value_zh.html: 仓库许可允许教育、研究与非营利使用，并向 BDD 与 BAIR Commons 成员及附属机构授予指定商业权利；其他商业许可需单独联系。标注还受 Waymo 条款约束。记录级许可与出处台账未发布。

value.html: WOMD scene and agent identifiers plus current/future timestamps feed a rule-based textual translation; GPT-4 Turbo produces five Q&A categories; the release stores original WOMD IDs and substituted Q&A IDs. Interaction and intention answers explicitly use current and future descriptions.

value_zh.html: WOMD 场景与智能体标识符外加当前/未来时间戳馈入基于规则的文本转换；GPT-4 Turbo 产生五类 Q&A；发布存储原始 WOMD IDs 与替换后的 Q&A IDs。交互与意图答案显式使用当前与未来描述。
